title: Ceiling Fan pets
notes: Source template, not stored in this repo: 15.279s vertical 720x1280 overhead costume-wipe under a spinning ceiling fan. Hypit media probe confirmed duration and 30fps. hypit media boundaries --rate 8 --threshold 0.1 returned no candidates because the camera is locked overhead; costume changes happen as out-of-focus wooden blades wipe the frame. Editorial story beats were taken from a 0.5s frame pass: formal look 0-5s, maid heart 5-8s, green tracksuit 8-12s, cream cardigan hug 12-13.5s, blue-hoodie wave 13.5-15.279s. Generation segments are an editorial grouping, 0-8s and 8-15.279s, so the join sits on the maid-to-tracksuit wipe instead of an even 7.639s cut through the maid beat. An ending at 12s would leave a 3.279s last segment, which is under 4s and is not used. Role slots are the customer remake, not a human. The fan is generated and is not in the customer's photo.

storyBeats.summary: Locked overhead shot of a cream living-room sofa. The pet lies on its back in a pale formal dress with light-blue trim and white formal boots, one paw raised behind its head, a small stuffed toy at its side. Wooden ceiling-fan blades rotate, out of focus, in the immediate foreground.

The same locked overhead shot. A passing blade wipes the frame and the formal dress becomes a black-and-white maid dress with a white lace apron and maid headpiece. The pet forms a heart with both paws. The stuffed toy stays on the sofa.

The same locked overhead shot. A passing blade wipes the frame into a green zip tracksuit with white piping. The pet lies on its back with both paws raised behind its head. The stuffed toy stays on the sofa.
The same locked overhead shot. A passing blade wipes the frame into a cream cardigan with a blue bow. The pet hugs the stuffed toy already on the sofa.
The same locked overhead shot. Another passing blade wipes the frame into a light-blue cropped hoodie, a visor cap, and a short pleated skirt. The pet waves both paws up at the camera.
